title: Janam Janamer Saathi
desc: The lives of two lovers, Seema and Jeeban, change when Seema's father gets her married to someone else. However, when Seema's husband commits suicide, she goes to the village where she met Jeeban.

title: Bhagya Debata
desc: Jagadish Mondal, an honest commoner, fights against the unjust practices, corruption and crime prevalent in society in a bid to help the poor and needy, while also taking care of his family.
